newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle quiet, no trade - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle quiet, no trade - USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a standstill in the Panhandle area Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry.

There were 15,900 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 100 head of CME cattle delivered to area packing plants and 15,600 formulated cattle to be shipped this week. The last established price was 67.00 on Thursday. Asking prices 68.00-69.00, bids have been 67.00.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Confirmed - None Week Ago - 10,500 Year Ago - 700
Wk to date - 15,900 Week Ago - 13,400 Year Ago - 2,900
